concept: Where the reader writes the next turn: the field's carved well that grows with the text, and one round button that sends or stops.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a chat composer as a flat white box with a blue paper-plane button
default_to_avoid.kind: chat composer, message input, prompt box
default_to_avoid.why_not: a blue send button brings a hue and a second loud thing to the screen; Pane uses the field's well and the loud white bead

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the composer is the same carved well as every field

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: send is the one loud bead on the composer

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Enter sends, Shift+Enter is a new line, and an answer arriving turns Send into Stop

options: A carved well with a loud bead
C a field and a text button
variants.picked: A carved well with a loud bead
variants.reason: A matches every field and keeps one loud thing (P3, P5). B adds a hue. C makes Send hard to hit with a thumb.

root.why: one well holds the field and the button, the field's own material

start.why: an attach button may sit before the field at touch height

field.why: the field inside drops its own groove so the well is the one shape

send.why: send or stop is the loud white bead at the end, low beside the last line

focus-within.why: the well takes the focus ring while the field inside has focus

focus-visible.why: the field keeps no ring of its own; the well carries it

hover.why: the field keeps no hover ring of its own inside the well

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks, so every part stays findable
